design.stage: EAB round 8: independent development selection of the budget split, frozen, then confirmation
design.question: Does a naming share selected on independent development cohorts, without test labels, beat the fixed 50/25/25 split on new confirmation cohorts at the same total budget?
design.prior_knowledge_disclosed: Designers know the retrospective allocation analysis (Table IX Opt.: at eps=1 all-recall acceptance 7.8 -> 81.8 with phi=.1, recall>=.5 certifiable at eps=3) and the source-disjoint ladder (32/8 records per client).
design.source_split: the 45000 private CIFAR images are split per class into two halves by a seeded permutation (seed 20261021): pool A for development cohorts only, pool B for confirmation cohorts only; no image is in both
design.partition: as release-disjoint-20261020 inside the phase pool: Dirichlet(alpha=.1) class proportions per client, images without replacement (renormalizing over non-exhausted classes); 20000 of 22500 pool images used once each

evaluation_records.development: public validation split (3967 labelled records, never used before for CIFAR selection)
evaluation_records.confirmation: public test split (4033 records); test labels never loaded in the development phase

design.composition: sequential, one total budget per deployment

teacher.model: linear softmax head on frozen 128-d DINOv2 features

design.candidate_family: as release-value private_validation.select: public count match, eight joint weights, private centered and coverage; exact LOO on the 10 labels
design.noise: one fresh exact naming release per (cohort, eps, configuration), shared by its label draws; fresh exact gain and class releases per case; sha256-derived keys with prefix BUDGETCONF-20261021

targets.gain>0: private candidate and gain lower > 0 (fixed or gain grid)
targets.all recalls>0: and every direct linear-band recall lower bound > 0 (fixed or class grid)
targets.all recalls>=.50: and every recall lower bound >= .5 (fixed or class grid)

design.bands: gain lower and direct linear-sum class bands of release-verify-teacher-20261020 class_bands; alpha_g=alpha_h=.025

selection.primary: per target and eps, the grid phi maximizing mean unconditional VALIDATION accuracy of the published classifier (candidate if accepted, else comparator) over the 10 development cohorts x 50 development draws
selection.secondary: label-free: the grid phi maximizing development acceptance rate (protected decisions only)
selection.ties: largest criterion; ties within 1e-12 broken by smallest |phi-.5|, then smaller phi
selection.inputs_used: development protected decisions, development candidate/comparator labels per region, validation labels
selection.inputs_not_used: confirmation cohorts, test split, clean development statistics
selection.frozen_in: SELECTION.json, written before any confirmation case is computed

design.confirmation: all configurations are run on the confirmation cohorts; only fixed versus frozen selections are tested

primary.H1: eps=1, all recalls>0: frozen primary selection minus fixed, paired over (draw, cohort), has crossed-bootstrap 95% lower bounds > 0 for BOTH acceptance and unconditional test accuracy (50 draws x 10 cohorts, 2000 replicates, seed 20261026)

predictions: eps=3, all recalls>=.50: frozen acceptance minus fixed has bootstrap lower bound > 0
no target/eps cell: frozen unconditional test accuracy more than 1 point below fixed
every frozen target/eps cell has false-accept rate <= 5% (alpha_g + alpha_h)
the selected class-target phi is below .5 at eps <= 1
descriptive: regret of each frozen selection against the confirmation-best grid phi
pilot size: how often a 1-cohort x 10-draw development subsample selects the same phi, and its confirmation accuracy
class tail: share of published classifiers with some test-class recall below 10%
design.confound_disclosed: 20 records per client (16/4) to make the two source pools disjoint at n=1000; settings differ from Table IX

reporting.amendments: implementation fixes after this freeze are logged in AMENDMENTS.json with time and reason
